item.title: Hozenji Yokocho: The Moss-Covered Lantern Alley — Guide
item.description: Hozenji Yokocho is a pair of narrow, stone-paved lanes tucked just south of the roar of Dotonbori, and stepping into them is like stepping back a century. Lined with tiny, atmospheric restaurants and bars behind lantern-lit facades, the alleys lead to Hozenji Temple, whose small Fudo Myo-o statue is famous for being completely covered in soft green moss — the result of generations of worshippers ladling water over it as they pray for success in love and business.
